name: pcgamingwiki
description: Read-only PCGamingWiki data for Claude: game facts, save and config locations, cloud sync, feature tables and (with a bot password) Cargo queries.

contact.title: Contact (email or URL)
contact.description: Added to the User-Agent, as PCGamingWiki asks of API clients, so its staff can reach you about your traffic. Optional.

bot_user.title: Bot user (optional)
bot_user.description: Only for cargo_query: YourName@BotName from Special:BotPasswords on PCGamingWiki, with the Cargo grant ticked. Leave empty to use the other tools only.

bot_password.title: Bot password (optional)
bot_password.description: The password Special:BotPasswords showed for that bot. Stored in your system's credential store; never logged or returned to the model.
